title: The same workout code can earn the member extra days again and again
what: After the desk checks a member's workout code, the owner gets a Give extra days button whenever at least one workout matches a check-in. Nothing remembers which workouts were already rewarded, so the member can show the same code (or a new one holding the same days) the next day and the owner is offered 3 more days again. The sheet does not say a reward was already given for these days.
expected: The check should show which workout days were already rewarded and offer the reward only for new ones, or say plainly that a reward was given for this code before.
fix_line: Remember the days a code reward covered and only offer days for new workouts

title: Numbers to confirm only shows a name the app user typed themselves
what: When someone in the app types a member's mobile number at check-in, Today asks the desk whether the number is really theirs. The only clue shown is the gym's member name and the name the app user chose for themselves. Anyone who names themselves after the member looks like a perfect match, and the question usually arrives when that person is not standing at the desk. One wrong Yes lets that person check in as the member from then on.
expected: The desk should get a way to be sure, for example only confirming while the person is at the desk, or a photo or a code sent to the member's own phone.
fix_line: Show the desk something the app user cannot choose, or ask only when they are at the desk

items.reason: No screen in this area sends member or lead text to an AI; the only AI references are layout room for the Assistant button, which lives in panel/assistant
